statement: Main technical risk: the mechanism requires passage provenance linking triples to a shared source passage, but the standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks (WebQSP, CWQ, MetaQA) are built on structured KGs (Freebase / synthetic movie graph) with no source passages. Either the evaluation must move to a provenance-bearing or text-derived KG, or 'context' must be redefined as graph neighbourhood, which is already covered by subgraph retrieval work.

evidence.quote: WebQuestionsSP (webqsp)[36] contains 4737 natural language questions that are answerable using Freebase as the knowledge base.
